name: device_id
description: Sparkplug Device ID. Null for node-level metrics.

name: metric_name
description: Metric name as published in Sparkplug BIRTH messages.

name: field_tag
description: The raw source-system tag/point name before normalization, e.g. 'AI_014'.

name: data_origin
description: One of 'sensor' (direct physical measurement), 'aggregate' (computed rollup), 'virtual' (calculated/derived, no direct sensor), 'manual' (human-entered).

name: effective_from
description: Start of validity for this row (slowly-changing-dimension versioning).

name: effective_to
description: End of validity for this row. Null means currently active.
